messages:
lucas: FYI customer ACME reporting structured-output suddenly failing after yesterday's model promotion. They parse an array of items but now get an object keyed by id. High impact: order ingestion pipeline fails (422).

olivia: can you drop the minimal request/response pair + model name and request_id?

lucas: request_id=rpc_20260310_9a7f, model=redwood/compat-llama4-v7.2.1, time=2026-03-10T14:12:05Z. sample request: 
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood/compat-llama4-v7.2.1",
  "input": "return JSON mode: items: list of {id, qty}\n",
  "mode": "json"
}
```
and response body returned by API (truncated):
```json
{
  "output": {
    "items_map": {
      "order_1": {"id": "order_1", "qty": 2},
      "order_2": {"id": "order_2", "qty": 1}
    }
  }
}
```
expected (what customer expects):
```json
{
  "output": {
    "items": [
      {"id": "order_1", "qty": 2},
      {"id": "order_2", "qty": 1}
    ]
  }
}
```

sam: thanks. did the canary for v7.2.1 finish yesterday? any rollout notes?

lucas: yes canary promoted at ~2026-03-09T22:00Z. multiple customers started hitting issues this morning.

eng-oncall: looking at the code path, the structured-output postprocessor has a mode that "normalizes" arrays into maps to preserve ids when it detects stable keys. possibly a heuristic change in the model tokens that now emits explicit id labels earlier, triggering normalization.

olivia: can you attach exact raw token stream or streaming chunks? need to see if model prepended an invariance comment that our postproc misinterprets.

lucas: pasted the stream capture (raw chunks):
```
{"chunk":"{\"items\":\n"}
{"chunk":"{\"order_1\": {\"id\":\"order_1\", \"qty\":2},\n"}
{"chunk":"\"order_2\": {\"id\":\"order_2\", \"qty\":1}\n"}
```
This is odd: first chunk started like an array then subsequent chunks look like object members. Customer parser treats streamed assembly as object.

support-bot: Escalation created: SR-48923 -> ENG (severity=P1) :thumbsup: @eng-oncall @olivia @sam

lee: quick ask: can we repro against previous stable tag (v7.1.9)? if that matches expected, rollback should be low-risk.

sam: repro'd locally against v7.1.9 using the same input and mode. It returns items as an array. diff looks like model emitted explicit brackets vs labeled keys on v7.2.1.

olivia: repro steps for eng:
1) curl the same generate payload with mode=json and streaming on.
2) capture the streamed chunks exactly (Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8).
3) run the postprocessor binary with --strict-json and compare outputs.
command: 
```bash
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood/compat-llama4-v7.2.1","input":"return JSON mode: items: list of {id, qty}","mode":"json","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | tee stream.log
```

lucas: customer is blocking deploys, they prefer rollback rather than debugging now. asked for status update to share.

eng-oncall: patch idea: disable the "array-to-map-normalization" heuristic in postproc for this model family until we can classify triggers. quick revert flag pushed to canary cluster; need approval to promote to stable rollback.

sam: I can push rollback to stable if eng approves. will coordinate with infra.

lee: note: before promoting rollback, let's run regression test suite on top-200 customer prompts to ensure we don't break other structured-output patterns. should be quick (<30m) with dedicated infra.

olivia: agreed. I'll kick off the test job now and monitor. if green, proceed with rollback.

lucas: pls keep customer updated. I've sent interim note: "we identified a post-processing heuristic triggered by a recent model promotion. engineering is testing a rollback now; we expect ETA ~45-90m."

eng-oncall: telemetry shows ~12 customers affected with similar array->object conversions since the v7.2.1 rollout. marking priority accordingly.

sam: test job finished: 218/218 prompts passed. preparing rollback plan and maintenance window for stable traffic; will perform in 20m unless objections.

olivia: no objections. proceed and post rollout notes. also create follow-up ticket to add explicit model compatibility tests for structured-output semantics.

lucas: thanks team. I'll keep the customer looped in. :pray:
